english.title: PHV holder accept private hire booking from other than operating centre - London
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a private hire vehicle operator's licence for London, accepted a private hire booking in London other than at an operating centre specified in your licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(1) and (5) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.

english.notes: Section 4(6) provides a defence in proceedings for this offence for an operator to show that he exercised all due diligence to avoid committing such an offence.
